notes.title: The Fan is now available!
notes.content:
At last, a few months of painful preparations after it's lightning-fast Greenlight campaign, [b]the game is out![/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28754990/88f6512571ce8a1b54fa045e3068685d44afbcc6.jpg[/img]

[b]Thank you[/b] all for your patience and support, and enjoy the [b]launch discount[/b] =)

Be sure to [b]share the news[/b] with all your friends on Facebook, Twitter, Reddit, Youtube, or at your sister's wedding!
